Pintle Chain

Pintle Chain

A chain of cast or forged offset links joined by pins. The wide end of each link wraps around the narrow end of the next, and it is used on agricultural and conveying equipment with heavy dust and shock.

Pintle Chain

铸造销合链

由铸造·锻造的 弯板式链节用销轴连接而成的链条。每个链节的宽端包住下一链节的窄端，用于粉尘·冲击较多的农机·输送设备。
